new.brief: Returns a newly created `GtkGesture` that recognizes single and multiple presses.
new.md:
Returns a newly created `GtkGesture` that recognizes
single and multiple presses.

doc.md:
Recognizes click gestures.

It is able to recognize multiple clicks on a nearby zone, which
can be listened for through the [`GestureClick::pressed`](xref:gtk:Gtk.GestureClick#event:pressed)
signal. Whenever time or distance between clicks exceed the GTK
defaults, [`GestureClick::stopped`](xref:gtk:Gtk.GestureClick#event:stopped) is emitted, and the
click counter is reset.

pressed.brief: Emitted whenever a button or touch press happens.
pressed.md: Emitted whenever a button or touch press happens.

released.brief: Emitted when a button or touch is released.
released.md:
Emitted when a button or touch is released.

`n_press` will report the number of press that is paired to
this event, note that [`GestureClick::stopped`](xref:gtk:Gtk.GestureClick#event:stopped) may
have been emitted between the press and its release, `n_press`
will only start over at the next press.

stopped.brief: Emitted whenever any time/distance threshold has been exceeded.
stopped.md: Emitted whenever any time/distance threshold has been exceeded.

unpaired-release.brief: Emitted whenever the gesture receives a release event that had no previous corresponding press.
unpaired-release.md:
Emitted whenever the gesture receives a release
event that had no previous corresponding press.

Due to implicit grabs, this can only happen on situations
where input is grabbed elsewhere mid-press or the pressed
widget voluntarily relinquishes its implicit grab.
